preconditions.description: The length of the input string is not more than 100.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string contains only lowercase and uppercase letters and underscores.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES' if any(name in stdin and stdin.count(name) == 1 for name in ['Danil', 'Olya', 'Slava', 'Ann', 'Nikita']) else return_value == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if the input string contains exactly one of Alex's friends' names exactly once, otherwise 'NO'.
